name: Broadcom
description: Broadcom has two businesses. Semiconductor solutions sells chips for data-center networking and AI (custom AI accelerators called XPUs, Ethernet switching and routing chips, NICs, optical parts, and racks built on its XPUs), plus wireless, broadband, storage and industrial chips. Infrastructure software (VMware products plus mainframe, security and network software) sells subscriptions and support to large enterprises. The software line earned an operating margin of 77% in FY2025 and 84% in Q3 FY2026. Semiconductors rose from 58% of revenue in FY2025 to 70% in Q3 FY2026 as AI demand grew.
